records.source: Ooh!... I can read it on your face. You're going to love it here in Pelican Town.#$b#If you're ever looking for something to do in the evening, stop by the saloon. That's where I work!
records.translation: 喔！……我能從你臉上看出來。你會喜歡鵜鶘鎮的。#$b#如果晚上想找點事做，就來酒館坐坐。那是我工作的地方！

records.source: Oh, you remembered my birthday! Thanks, @! That's really nice of you.$h
records.translation: 喔，你記得我的生日！謝謝你，@！你真貼心。$h

records.source: Oh, you remembered my birthday! Thanks, @! That's really ni--$h#$b#...*sniff*...*sniff*... what is that smell?$s#$b#... What is this...?$s
records.translation: 喔，你記得我的生日！謝謝你，@！你真貼——$h#$b#……*嗅嗅*……*嗅嗅*……這是什麼味道？$s#$b#……這是什麼……？$s

records.source: Yes, I'd love to dance with you, @!$h#$e#Now I'm excited... This is going to be a lot of fun!
records.translation: 好啊，我很樂意和你跳舞，@！$h#$e#現在我興奮起來了……一定會非常有趣！

records.source: Wow, thank you! I've heard that if you drink this before bed you'll have vivid dreams.
records.translation: 哇，謝謝你！我聽說睡前喝下這個，會做非常清晰的夢。

records.source: Oh, good, it's still warm... Poor thing, where's it's mother? *Whisper* ...I'll be your mother, don't worry... Poor baby.$s#$b#I'm glad you gave this to me, @. I'll take very good care of it.
records.translation: 喔，太好了，還是溫的……可憐的小東西，牠的媽媽在哪裡？*低語*……別擔心，我會當你的媽媽……可憐的寶寶。$s#$b#@，很高興你把它交給我。我會好好照顧牠。

records.source: $c 0.5#Oh, wow... Thank you! This color perfectly captures my mood today.$h#The warm, soothing energy of this stone helps us re-center our thoughts... It's actually just what I needed on a day like this. Thanks!
records.translation: $c 0.5#喔，哇……謝謝你！這個顏色完美呈現了我今天的心情。$h#這顆石頭溫暖而舒緩的能量能幫助我們重新集中思緒……這正是今天的我所需要的。謝謝！

records.source: $c 0.5#That's funny, I had a dream that you would give me a piece of jade today!$h#Ooh, it's jade! This is supposed to attract wealth... And who couldn't do with a few extra coins in the pocket?$h
records.translation: $c 0.5#真有趣，我夢見你今天會送我一塊翡翠！$h#喔，是翡翠！據說能招來財富……誰不想口袋裡多幾枚硬幣呢？$h

records.source: $c 0.5#Oh, it's beautiful, @! I hope you didn't put yourself in too much danger to get this.$h#Ah, an amethyst! This will protect me on those late nights working at the Saloon.
records.translation: $c 0.5#喔，真漂亮，@！希望你沒有為了取得它而陷入太大危險。$h#啊，是紫水晶！它會在我深夜於酒館工作時保護我。

records.source: $c 0.5#Wow, look at that color! It matches perfectly with my outfit.$h#Oh, this is perfect... I've been feeling a little sluggish lately. Rubies are great for energizing the spirit!
records.translation: $c 0.5#哇，看看這個顏色！和我的服裝完美相襯。$h#喔，這太完美了……我最近覺得有點倦怠。紅寶石非常適合為精神注入活力！

records.source: $c 0.5#It's so smooth! When I hold it... I can feel the energy of all the mermaids in the sea. Thank you!#Thank you! I'm gonna put this under my pillow, and hopefully I'll dream about the ocean.
records.translation: $c 0.5#好光滑！握著它時……我能感受到海中所有美人魚的能量。謝謝你！#謝謝你！我要把它放在枕頭下，希望能夢見海洋。

records.source: $c 0.5#Oh!... Heheh... I know exactly why you gave me this stone today. Very interesting...#Wow, it's beautiful! This color makes me think of all the spiritual power within the forest... Can you feel that wood energy?
records.translation: $c 0.5#喔！……嘿嘿……我完全明白你今天為什麼送我這顆石頭。很有意思……#哇，真漂亮！這種顏色讓我想起森林裡所有的靈性力量……你能感受到那股木之能量嗎？

records.source: There must be a meaning behind this... Nature is trying to tell us something.$3#$e#What, though? I can't tell... It's hard to read. I feel a strong presence, though...$3
records.translation: 這背後一定有某種意義……大自然正試圖告訴我們什麼。$3#$e#但究竟是什麼？我看不出來……很難解讀。不過我感受到一股強烈的存在……$3

records.source: Can you feel it? The forest is singing! The trees are dancing with joy!
records.translation: 你感受到了嗎？森林正在歌唱！樹木正歡欣起舞！

records.source: That was a beautiful wedding... I'm really happy for you and Haley!$h
records.translation: 那場婚禮很美……我真替你和海莉開心！$h

records.source: Haley is too proud to be heartbroken over the divorce... Or at least to show it.$3
records.translation: 海莉太驕傲，不會因離婚而心碎……至少不會表現出來。$3

records.source: Hello @. I had a feeling I'd be seeing you today.
records.translation: 你好，@。我有預感今天會見到你。

records.source: Nothing is more sad than an injured animal...$s
records.translation: 沒有什麼比受傷的動物更令人難過……$s

records.source: Now that you have a sheep, you'll be able to make cloth! That'll open up a whole new world of tailoring possibilities. Just wait and see.
records.translation: 現在你有了綿羊，就能製作布料！那會開啟一個充滿裁縫可能性的全新世界。等著瞧吧。

records.source: Have you ever tried cooking without a recipe? It's kind of liberating.#$b#And who knows... you might discover something amazing!
records.translation: 你試過不用食譜做菜嗎？那種感覺很自由。#$b#而且誰知道呢……你也許會發現驚人的美味！

records.source: My outing with Clint was pretty fun!#$b#Although, he spilled a root beer all over himself within ten minutes of getting there, and then barely said a word the rest of the night.$3
records.translation: 我和克林特出去玩得很開心！#$b#不過抵達不到十分鐘，他就把沙士灑得滿身都是，接著整晚幾乎一句話也沒說。$3

records.source: Hey, I saw you at Sam's show. It was fun!$h#$e#The city smelled pretty bad, though.$s
records.translation: 嘿，我在山姆的演出上看到你了。很好玩！$h#$e#不過城市的氣味相當糟糕。$s

records.source: I won't forget our camping trip any time soon...$l
records.translation: 我很久都不會忘記我們的露營之旅……$l

records.source: %Emily has a big smile on her face.
records.translation: %Emily臉上露出燦爛的笑容。

records.source: We're going to have a lot of fun together, I just know it.$h
records.translation: 我就知道，我們在一起會有很多樂趣。$h

records.source: Well, now that you're married, I assume Shane won't be coming to the Saloon as much!#$e#That's probably a good thing, but it's always a little sad to lose a regular...$s
records.translation: 嗯，既然你們結婚了，我想謝恩不會再那麼常來酒館！#$e#這大概是好事，但失去一位常客總有點令人難過……$s

records.source: Oh, I like this place! It's full of parrots!
records.translation: 喔，我喜歡這個地方！到處都是鸚鵡！

records.source: Ah... my lungs feel perfect.
records.translation: 啊……我的肺感覺舒服極了。

records.source: Can you feel it? The ocean has a profound healing energy.
records.translation: 你感受到了嗎？海洋擁有深邃的療癒能量。

records.source: Are you having fun, @? You need to remember to take breaks now and then too!
records.translation: 玩得開心嗎，@？你也要記得偶爾休息一下！

records.source: It's nice to be on this side of the bar for once!$h
records.translation: 難得站在吧台這一邊，感覺真好！$h

records.source: If you open your heart to the sun, you can feel a loving energy inside of you.$h
records.translation: 如果向太陽敞開心扉，就能感受到體內充滿愛的能量。$h

records.source: %Emily is lost in the music.
records.translation: %Emily沉醉在音樂中。

records.source: Of course, my love. I've been looking forward to this!$h
records.translation: 當然，親愛的。我一直很期待！$h

records.source: I'm very sorry... but I've already agreed to dance with someone else.$u
records.translation: 非常抱歉……但我已經答應和別人跳舞。$u

records.source: @... You broke my heart... I just can't talk to you anymore.$s#$e#Please, let me try to heal...$s
records.translation: @……你傷透了我的心……我再也無法和你說話。$s#$e#請讓我試著療癒自己……$s

records.source: B...But I thought we had a special bond... *sniff*$s
records.translation: 可、可是我以為我們之間有特別的羈絆……*吸鼻子*$s

records.source: Oh, that's beautiful... I have a friend who would love that! But she lives far from here...
records.translation: 喔，真漂亮……我有個朋友一定會喜歡！但她住得離這裡很遠……

records.source: @... I'm ready to give you a second chance. I still have faith that there's a good person inside of you.$s
records.translation: @……我準備好再給你一次機會。我仍然相信你內心有善良的一面。$s

records.source: Have I told you Haley and I are sisters? Strange, isn't it?
records.translation: 我告訴過你海莉和我是姊妹嗎？很奇怪，對吧？

records.source: I have a secret hobby, but I won't say any more.#$e#Maybe I'll show you some day.$h
records.translation: 我有一項祕密嗜好，但不能再多說了。#$e#也許有一天會展示給你看。$h

records.source: This world is full of spirits and magic... Some don't believe me, but I know it's true.#$e#I can see it in your eyes... you believe in the other world, like me.
records.translation: 這個世界充滿精靈與魔法……有些人不相信我，但我知道這是真的。#$e#我能從你眼中看出來……你和我一樣相信另一個世界。

records.source: I wish Haley would get a job or at least contribute to cooking and cleaning.$s#$e#I think she's hoping to marry someone rich.$u
records.translation: 真希望海莉能找份工作，或至少幫忙做飯和打掃。$s#$e#我覺得她希望嫁給有錢人。$u

records.source: I have to say, now that Haley's gone I've had a much easier time keeping things in order.
records.translation: 不得不說，海莉搬走後，維持家裡整潔輕鬆多了。

records.source: There's good people in this town who just can't seem to find happiness. It makes me sad.$u#$e#Working in the saloon, I hear first-hand about everyone's problems.$u
records.translation: 鎮上有些好人似乎就是找不到幸福。這讓我很難過。$u#$e#在酒館工作，我會親耳聽到每個人的煩惱。$u

records.source: I work part-time at Gus' saloon. It pays the bills.
records.translation: 我在格斯的酒館兼職。靠這份工作支付生活開銷。

records.source: I'm just working at Gus' to make ends meet... but my real passion is tailoring.$u#$e#I made these clothes from scratch, see?
records.translation: 我在格斯那裡工作只是為了維持生計……真正熱愛的是裁縫。$u#$e#這身衣服是我從頭做起的，看到了嗎？

records.source: Oh, hi... It's nice of you to visit me like this.$h
records.translation: 喔，嗨……你特地來看我，真貼心。$h

records.source: You know, @... I think the future looks bright for both of us.
records.translation: 你知道嗎，@……我覺得我們兩人的未來都很光明。

records.source: I've heard rumors of rare and powerful magic rings, forged long ago by forgotten civilizations. I'm not sure if it's true or just a fairy tale.
records.translation: 我聽說有些罕見而強大的魔法戒指，是被遺忘的文明在很久以前打造的。不確定這是真事還是童話。

records.source: You catch fish? I just hope you treat the poor things humanely.$s#$e#Every critter deserves our respect, even the slimy ones.
records.translation: 你會釣魚？只希望你能人道地對待那些可憐的小生命。$s#$e#每種生物都值得我們尊重，就算是黏糊糊的也一樣。

records.source: Have faith... every day you're taking one more step on the path of your destiny.
records.translation: 要有信心……每一天，你都在命運之路上向前多走一步。
